BUY TICKETS

Directed by Tobe Hooper // Rated R

Strange and creepy happenings beset an average California family when ghosts commune with them through the television set. Initially friendly and playful, the spirits turn menacing. When five-year-old daughter Carol Ann (Heather O’Rourke) goes missing, parents Steve (Craig T. Nelson) and Diane (JoBeth Williams) enlist a parapsychologist (Zelda Rubinstein) and her team of ghost busters for help. Yet it never occurs to anyone to get rid of the creepy clown doll in the kids bedroom. 

DJ Shane Kramer curates nights of vinyl, music videos, and cinematic nostalgia. Host of Friday I’m In Love and Sinatra to Slayer, his sets blend disco, new wave, soul, and pop through the music that shaped generations.
